name: Ashley the Pirate
source:
This game has a pirate theme, and the plot is about a princess who ends up suffering a "shipwreck" and ends up in a village, she is in search of her father, and will do anything to find him, even become a pirate!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/YioruYioru/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
该游戏以海盗为题材，剧情讲述一位公主遭遇“海难”流落到一个村庄，她为了寻找自己的父亲，不择手段，甚至成为一名海盗！

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/YioruYioru/about]Patreon[/url]]
